title: LIVE WAVE PERIOD & DIRECTION
source_name: NOAA/NCEP Great Lakes Wave Unstructured v2.1 (GLWUv2.1, WAVEWATCH III) — PERPW peak period + WVDIR direction, surface analysis
variable: PERPW peak (primary) wave period, surface analysis step (filed seconds as-is, no conversion); WVDIR surface direction drives the travel arrows only
display_units: seconds between crests (arrows show travel direction)
coverage: Lake water only: Great Lakes cut by the shared NOAA shoreline mask, land fully transparent.
arrows: Arrows show the toward-travel vector (WVDIR filed FROM direction + 180 deg, standard oceanographic handling), white shaft with dark outline.
what: How far apart the wave crests are right now (peak period, seconds) with arrows showing which way the waves travel. Long-interval swell (high seconds, purple) carries far more energy than short chop at the same height.
why_extreme: Long 10-12 s swell compresses into violet/dark-purple; ordinary 2-6 s chop owns most of the color resolution.
